qfd_sp_vector_memory_bv.structure: copy 0 = qwen-rtl-finish's 64 row banks x 2 ot_sram_1r1w_256x256 with the parallel ME x service (a beat now reads only the banks of its tuple's rows) and the row read port; 3 SU replica copies (one per operand va / vb / vc), each 16 row banks x 2 ot_sram_1r1w_1024x256 (695 of 1,024 lines used); writes broadcast to every copy at the same edge through one per-bank write register set; per bank: SU lane rows first (<= 5 consecutive rows, distinct banks), then the skid queues (SQD 2) of the engine-edge maxima row, the reducer element and the sequencer row (base commit order), then the merge's result row; the 6:1 ME result merge (ot_qfd_res_merge, CRB-deep input FIFO a band) inside; land_cnt (landed result bursts) to the tree top, me_ok (AND of the band serializers' rok) to the die's me_mem_ok
qfd_sp_vector_memory_bv.su_ports: per operand a descriptor {re0, re1, a0, a1} (lane 0 / lane 1 strobe and address; stride a1 - a0 in {0, 1}, the Qwen program's VM operand strides, else w_fault); all SW lanes answered at the FIXED latency 1 + VL, VL = 7 (base 1); lane writes {mask, a0, a1, data} (stride 0: highest masked lane wins); reducer element write
qfd_sp_vector_memory_bv.exactness_argument: uniform latency: every SU read and every write presented at edge t reaches the macros at edge t + 4 (descriptor register, broadcast register, per-bank register beside the macro), and a 1R1W macro reads the old word on a same-edge write, so an SU read sees exactly the writes presented before it (the base's registered-read / same-edge-write order); a skid entry that misses its edge is LATE and any read of its row or other write onto its row is w_hazard (the contract); the x path keeps qwen-rtl-finish's x_hazard over every landing row; ME result rows land at a variable time and the tree top counts LANDED bursts
qfd_sp_vector_memory_bv.benches: rtl/test/qwen_vm_me/tb_qfd_vm_bv_ports.sv (every port at once against the behavioural VM semantics + 6 band serializers under the engine stall loop): PASS SEED 5 (30,000 cycles: 45,333 SU operand reads, 6,994 row reads, 2,072 x tuples, 1,213 bursts, 1,205 land steps), SEED 3 (40,000), SEED 9 (60,000, RS 10), NRB 64 / SW 64 / ELEMS 65,536 (20,000: 30,303 SU reads, 1,346 tuples, 821 bursts); mutants FAIL: SU lane select (MUT 1: 44,846 SU answers wrong), x shift (MUT 2), serializer mask swap (SMUT 1: land 40,948 / image 69)
qfd_sp_vector_memory_bv.cost: SU operand reads at 1 + 7 edges (base 1, ab 1 + 4): the SU element latency is ML = 7 (+3 over ab); a result burst takes max(rows, 1) merge cycles at one row a cycle; the engine pauses (me_mem_ok) when a band store has < RS + 2 bursts of room

qfd_sp_su64_sfu_bv.structure: ot_qfd_sp_su64_sfu_ab with the banked-VM ports: descriptors straight from the lane 0 / lane 1 registers (no logic before the pins), the memory's answers delayed ML - VL, the constant ROM's ML - (IS + OS + CRX), the embedding decode ML, lanes at ML = max(IS + OS + CRX, VL) = 7; a lane that did not read HOLDS its previous answer (3 x SW x 32 flops: the base port's registered, held-when-not-read contract; without it the lane datapath saw different don't-care values and an op's first element after a partial vector differed)
qfd_sp_su64_sfu_bv.benches: rtl/test/qwen_vm_me/tb_qfd_su_vm_bv.sv (master ON the banked VM vs bare ot_hdc_vstream + ot_qfd_su_embed on the behavioural VM; cross-op RAW through the banks): PASS SW 8 IS = OS = 1 CRX 2 (120 ops; va/vb/vc/crom/vm/red/kv events 980/663/745/753/299/214/328), PASS IS = OS = 2 CRX 3 (120 ops); mutants FAIL: constant-ROM bit (MUT 1), VM lane select (VMUT 1)

qfd_sp_res_ser.structure: per band: the 8 result slots (2 port elements x PQ 4) captured on engine edges (me_en sampling: a paused engine's held outputs are taken once) into 8 x ot_sram_1r1w_64x512 (DB 64 bursts) + row / mask / header flops; one beat {row, mask, data, end, nul} a cycle in slot order under CRB credits (16) to the VM merge, a NUL beat for a burst with no row in the band; rok (registered) while >= RS + 2 bursts of room (RS 40: the stall loop to the die's me_mem_ok and back)

qfd_sp_tree_top_l.rtl: rtl/qwen_sys/rtl_finish_20261007/ot_qfd_sp_tree_top.sv ot_qfd_sp_tree_top LANDED = 1 (land_cnt input, IS-stationed); ot_qwen_me_spctl_w12 LANDED (rtl/hdc/ot_qwen_me_spine_h_w12.sv, default 0 = base) counts landed bursts for progress and holds idle until every emitted burst landed; ot_qwen_me_spport_w12 gains o_ov (the burst marker aligned with o_we, additive)
qfd_sp_tree_top_l.benches: rtl/test/qwen_vm_me/tb_qfd_spine_landed.sv: ot_qwen_me_spine_h_w12 writing a behavioural memory vs ot_qfd_spine_part LANDED + 3 band serializers + the banked VM merge, one gated engine clock driven by the stall loop: PASS (14,229 engine edges, 306 ops, 4,816 bursts all landed, 13 idle-rise checks: every result / maxima row equal to the reference, progress never ahead, lockstep of every other output, o_ov aligned); SMUT FAIL; tb_qfd_tree_top_lockstep (LANDED 0) unchanged: 30,000 cycles, 817 ops, 0 mismatching cycles

die.floorplan: a third spine column (777.6 um) M between the vertical link channel and the E column: W | VCH | M | E.  The outer columns keep the band-half slabs beside their tile arrays (no block word crosses the spine); M holds the banked VM (777.6 x 6,220.8, centred on the hub) with the stream unit abutted below it (descriptor bus, 2,367 + 6,144 M5 pin pairs, no stations) and the sequencer below that; each band's W primary slab is a stack: the band's result serializer (777.6 x 518.4) abutted below it (rq 4,425 b), the band-lane block (777.6 x 1,131.84) abutted above it (tw / ty 4,096 b each)

die.tree_lanes: the qwen-rtl-finish partition's 16 monolithic lanes (ot_qwen_spine_lane over all 48 level-TCUT positions) do not fit this die: 16 x 6 bands x 2 x 256 b of words across the 31 mm spine with no wire-stage budget between lanes and port elements (TREE_LAT hold only); the first r21m attempt with 16 central lane instances failed relay placement (no free spot within 1.4 mm).  r21m places the lanes per band (levels TCUT+1..TCUT+3 of the band's 8 positions, 16 lanes) stacked on the band slab; the tree top holds the levels above.  The per-band lane RTL is OPEN.
die.port_elements: the band slab halves (r17: 8 routed port-group elements each) host the W12 port elements; the slab reservation is 96 port groups against the RTL's 48 result ports (OPEN, unchanged from r21)
